1.name: Attack grunt 1 (hah)
1.desc: A young man's short, clear 'hah!' of effort as he swings. The most ordinary of the four.

2.name: Short kiai
2.desc: A clean karate-style 'hyah!', a little longer and louder than the grunt.

3.name: Male shout
3.desc: A short, plain man's shout ('hey!' with effort), very dry.

4.name: Attack grunt 2 (hya)
4.desc: Another take from the same warrior grunt set: a quick, higher 'hya!'.
